parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-04 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 4201.4 | 5.06 | 5.06
2 | 2238.9 | 4.35 | 9.41
3 | 343.9 | 31.91 | 41.32
4 | 25.0 | 0.99 | 42.31
5 | 10.9 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as QQQ-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-04
Curve type: QQQ-type
Aquifer depth: 9.41 – 41.32 m
Recommendation: Drill to a target depth of approximately 45–50 m to fully penetrate the potential weathered/fractured aquifer zone identified in Layer 3. Caution is advised regarding potential high clay content or mineralized water in the conductive layers below 41.3 m.
